channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Cozy Cleaner
item.description: Cozy Cleaner is a relaxing cleaning game where you tidy and organize rooms messed up by playful cats. Pick up clutter, wipe away dirt, and bring order back to every space for a calming, refreshing experience with cozy soundtracks.

item.title: SOS OPS!
item.description: SOS OPS! is more than a game. Your task is to save the city. You will find yourself in the epicenter of madness, where co-op missions with friends will raise the adrenaline to the limit!

item.title: Murky Divers
item.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

item.title: Godhood
item.description: Create your Religion, raise your Disciples, and guide them to bring you glory! Inspire growth in your Disciples so they may challenge the false gods and convert their followers. Defeat your rivals, and become the One Truth!

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Ambusher Pack
item.description: Experience a strategic new approach to hunting with weapons and equipment designed for effectively ambushing prey in the wild.
